evidence.reason: Systemd distinguishes `%i` (escaped instance) from `%I` (unescaped instance). The current line substitutes the escaped `instance` for both specifiers, so an instance such as `crq\x2dtick` makes `Service=%I.service` expand to `crq\x2dtick.service` instead of `crq-tick.service`, causing the dependency scan to miss the live binding. This is an ordinary implementation defect, not a new requirement.
